name: Everglades National Park
description: At the southern tip of Florida, Everglades National Park protects a vast, shallow "river of grass" that creeps toward the sea at about a quarter mile a day. Across more than 1.5 million acres of sawgrass marsh, mangroves and wetlands, you can spot alligators, crocodiles, manatees and hundreds of bird species. It is North America's top breeding ground for tropical wading birds, though it remains on the List in Danger.
